modules.name: ontologylab.alias_authority
modules.rationale: Filters which proposal name/alias surfaces may be offered to EPPO/CAS registry lookup; does not acquire or persist documents.

secondary_stages.why: Only extractor-stamped proposals carry alias_authority; this gate sits on the extraction boundary, not ingest.

hidden_fallbacks.what: alias_authority is None authorizes name+every alias (pre-4C compatibility), so unattested surfaces can mint registry identity.

modules.name: ontologylab.authority
modules.rationale: Additive v2 Work/Representation/Observation DDL only; no transformation function, applied from KGStore.open.

secondary_stages.why: _SCHEMA defines works, work_identifiers, document_observations used as ingest identity tables.
Same script also creates provenance_outbox and v2_migration_ledger.

modules.name: ontologylab.authority_repo
modules.rationale: Typed Work create plus identifier reserve-observe-assert; the v2 identity write used by ingest_item.

secondary_stages.why: IdentifierOwnedConflict / SecondDoiAttachConflict are identity-ownership decisions, not byte acquire.

modules.name: ontologylab.doi_backfill
modules.rationale: Read-only exact-resolver DOI backfill classifier for NULL-doi legacy rows (D10 policy).

secondary_stages.why: Only imported by migration_backfill; unused by collect/ingest, so the Normalize policy lives on the cutover path.

modules.name: ontologylab.file_lifecycle
modules.rationale: Operation-owned staging of Representation bytes and ready/quarantine reconcile; the file half of ingest, not a second document writer.

secondary_stages.why: reconcile_files/read_ready_text are reused by extract, citations, h1, pack, and work_view (fan_in=17).

hidden_fallbacks.what: orphan staging rmdir failures are swallowed with except OSError: pass.
ready_byte_length returns 0 on PathEscapeError/OSError, hiding unreadable ready files as empty.

modules.name: ontologylab.identity_decisions
modules.rationale: Audited attach/retract/collision operations with actor/reason; human identity decisions, not acquire.

modules.name: ontologylab.ingestion
modules.rationale: Production collect persist seam; parallel flow — always delegates to shadow rather than the v2 surface.

secondary_stages.why: finalize_shadow_writes commits, reconciles files, and projects outbox after persist.

hidden_fallbacks.what: ingest_documents hardcodes ingestion_shadow.shadow_persist; no nameable slot to choose the v2 surface.

modules.name: ontologylab.ingestion_service
modules.rationale: CANONICAL v2 ingest: one IngestItem → typed receipt via SAVEPOINT; both parallel flows eventually write here.

secondary_stages.why: Creates/attaches Work, Representation, Observation, and identifiers inside the same item write.

hidden_fallbacks.what: identifier_owned conflict implicitly retries ingest onto existing_work_id without a new caller decision.
staged-dir rmdir failures swallowed with except OSError: pass.

modules.name: ontologylab.ingestion_shadow
modules.rationale: PARALLEL collect adapter: legacy DOI/hash document identity plus a v2 Observation; FULL_V2_AUTHORITY stays off.

secondary_stages.why: _persist_one dedupes by documents.doi/content_hash then calls ingest_item, a second identity policy beside the service.

hidden_fallbacks.what: FULL_V2_AUTHORITY = False hard-wires legacy_compatible dual-write; v2 authority is not a selectable slot.
except Exception: log collect.failed and continue, dropping the document with no receipt.

modules.name: ontologylab.ingestion_surfaces
modules.rationale: PARALLEL CLI/HTTP/queue/sample seam over ingest_work_items; production collect does not use this path.

hidden_fallbacks.what: Non-mapping payload becomes an empty IngestItem instead of a parse error, failing later as invalid_item.

modules.name: ontologylab.literature
modules.rationale: Scholarly-query planning and citation-neighborhood expansion that drive literature collect, not Work ingest.

secondary_stages.why: LLM query-axis formulation is expansion-shaped work sitting in front of fetch.

hidden_fallbacks.what: engine is None returns a raw-topic ScholarlyQuery and continues.
EngineError and empty parse fail open to the same topic fallback.

modules.name: ontologylab.literature_artifacts
modules.rationale: Writes the merged literature corpus JSONL/summary for one research job; side artifact of collect.

modules.name: ontologylab.literature_citations
modules.rationale: Bounded OpenAlex citation-neighborhood fetch of RawDocuments for collect.

hidden_fallbacks.what: HTTPError/URLError/ResponseTooLarge return None and skip the seed/axis with no typed failure.
parse_openalex TypeError/ValueError returns [] instead of failing the expansion.

modules.name: ontologylab.normalization
modules.rationale: Registry lookup that stamps EPPO/CAS/MoA onto extraction proposals; not canonicalization of acquired documents.

secondary_stages.why: Sole importer is extractor; this Resolve step is a cross-stage shortcut off ingest.

hidden_fallbacks.what: cache_absent pops normalization flags and returns the proposal unchanged, switching the feature off mid-run.
Same cache_absent early-return for CAS/MoA.

modules.name: ontologylab.preferred
modules.rationale: Pure preferred-representation-v1 ranking over a Work's candidates; canonical Representation projection, never stored.

secondary_stages.why: Ranking is the selection policy later consumed by selection_store / review.

modules.name: ontologylab.provenance_outbox
modules.rationale: Observation outbox insert plus deterministic JSONL projector; provenance lifecycle, not a pipeline stage transform.

secondary_stages.why: project_outbox is invoked from collect/ingest finalize (ingestion.py, ingest_routes, main cmd_ingest).

modules.name: ontologylab.reconciliation
modules.rationale: Shared CLI/HTTP facade over attach/retract/compensate/collision; duplicates identity_decisions + work_redirects.

secondary_stages.why: list_state/inspect_work exist so CLI and HTTP return the same dicts.

modules.name: ontologylab.registry
modules.rationale: Mega-module: EPPO/PubChem/MoA import plus RegistryCache/CASRegistryCache lookup used at extract time.

secondary_stages.why: import_eppo/import_pubchem install local identity registries (allowlisted HTTP only for verify_eppo_api).

hidden_fallbacks.what: Missing cache file: resolve() returns None / resolve_with_status cache_absent without failing the run.

modules.name: ontologylab.searchquery
modules.rationale: Topic→paper-API query rewrite that precedes collect fetch; parallel to literature.formulate_scholarly_queries.

secondary_stages.why: Multi-query formulation is expansion-shaped and documented to fail open like expansion.

hidden_fallbacks.what: engine is None returns the raw topic and the search proceeds.
any Exception from engine.generate fail-opens to topic.
parse_search_query except Exception returns (None, ''), which then fail-opens to topic.

modules.name: ontologylab.sources
modules.rationale: Publisher-source registry and credential locators (keychain/env); defines where fulltext evidence comes from.

secondary_stages.why: resolve_source_key is a keychain/env adapter, not an acquire transform.

hidden_fallbacks.what: load_sources fail-soft to [] on missing/corrupt JSON, hiding Source-stage failure from collect.
Malformed entries are skipped with continue.
api_key_env is the documented secret fallback when Keychain is unavailable.
migrate_source_keychain_accounts swallows KeychainError and leaves that source unmigrated.

modules.name: ontologylab.work_redirects
modules.rationale: Append-only Work merge/compensate redirects and canonical_work projection (alias/merge).

modules.name: ontologylab.work_view
modules.rationale: On-read Work snapshot including computed preferred Representation; canonical view of acquired identity.

secondary_stages.why: server/routes and reconciliation.inspect_work expose the same snapshot as a read API.

findings: Two production ingest pipelines: collect (ontologylab/main.py:587, ontologylab/server/routes.py:2066, ontologylab/server/jobs.py:1046) calls ingestion.ingest_documents → ingestion_shadow.shadow_persist; authority ingest (ontologylab/main.py:447, ontologylab/server/ingest_routes.py:25) calls ingestion_surfaces.run_ingest → ingest_work_items. Canonical writer is ingestion_service.ingest_item (ontologylab/ingestion_service.py:300). file_lifecycle is the shared byte half (prepare_representation_payload:180, reconcile_files:430), not a third document flow.

Shadow is a hidden default engine: ingest_documents hardcodes shadow_persist (ontologylab/ingestion.py:110) while FULL_V2_AUTHORITY = False (ontologylab/ingestion_shadow.py:33); circular imports between ingestion.py and ingestion_shadow.py. Not a nameable slot+contract.
shadow_persist silently drops documents: except Exception continue at ontologylab/ingestion_shadow.py:414 after logging collect.failed, so collect can finish without a per-item failed receipt.

registry.py is a mega-module (758 loc) mixing Source install (import_eppo:218, import_pubchem:395, install_starter_moa:369) with Resolve caches (RegistryCache:652, CASRegistryCache:549, MoARegistryCache:606) and HTTP verify_eppo_api:736.

Duplicate fail-open query engines: searchquery.formulate_search_query (ontologylab/searchquery.py:184) and literature.formulate_scholarly_queries (ontologylab/literature.py:154) both substitute the raw topic when engine is missing or errors; literature also re-exports expand_citation_neighborhood.

Entity Resolve (alias_authority, normalization, registry) is not on the ingest path: normalization.normalize_proposal is imported only by extractor, while ingest identity is Work/DOI in authority_repo/ingestion_service — overlapping Resolve vocab on a later stage.
alias_authority.surface_plan (ontologylab/alias_authority.py:37) authorizes all surfaces when classification is missing (legacy SHA-pin compatibility), an implicit fallback against D11.

sources.load_sources fail-soft to [] (ontologylab/sources.py:181) and resolve_source_key returns None (ontologylab/sources.py:141), so a corrupt/missing publisher registry is indistinguishable from 'no sources configured'.

Cross-stage ingest shortcut: research_extract.attach_explicit_completeness_variants calls ingest_item directly (ontologylab/research_extract.py:105), bypassing both collect (ingestion.py) and ingest surfaces.

file_lifecycle fan_in=17 spans Acquire, Extract, Verify, Publish, and Consume; staged-file ownership is not confined to the ingest stage (callers include citation_bind, h1_*, pack_v2_closure, work_view).
kgstore.insert_document (ontologylab/kgstore.py:2029) remains a third persist path (competency.py) beside shadow dual-write and ingestion_service INSERT INTO documents.
literature_citations._get_optional (ontologylab/literature_citations.py:43) treats network/HTTP failures as empty expansion, overlapping Verify-shaped citation work with silent Acquire skips.
doi_backfill.plan_doi_backfill (ontologylab/doi_backfill.py:57) is the Normalize DOI policy but is only reached from migration_backfill, so collect never applies D10 backfill.
ingestion_service retries identifier_owned conflicts onto the winner Work (ontologylab/ingestion_service.py:326) without an explicit Resolve decision, a cross-stage identity shortcut inside Acquire.
